# Approve and pay a shareholder distribution

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a company proposes a dividend or another distribution to its owners. A reviewed distribution decision with authorized payments, required records and reconciled ownership and tax treatment.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is UK; local distribution rules must be reviewed separately. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Prepare the proposed distribution and ownership facts

agent-runnable


Collect current accounts, cash forecasts, ownership rights, investor agreements and the proposed amount and date. Separate cash on hand from funds legally available for distribution.

- Sources: [GOV.UK director information: dividends](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/director-information-hub-dividends)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Confirm legal capacity and tax treatment

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Qualified company-law and tax advisers assess the entity, jurisdiction, restrictions and recipient treatment. Keep uncertain distributable amounts or required consents unresolved and block payment until reviewed.

- Sources: [GOV.UK director information: dividends](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/director-information-hub-dividends)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Draft the calculation and approval pack

agent-runnable


Prepare recipient allocations from verified rights and record the assumptions and evidence used. Reconcile rounding and currency handling without replacing the professional determination of lawful capacity.

- Sources: [GOV.UK director information: dividends](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/director-information-hub-dividends)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Obtain the required corporate approvals

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The authorized decision-makers approve the specific amount, recipients and conditions through the reviewed governance route. Retain resolutions and any required consent before releasing funds.

- Sources: [GOV.UK director information: dividends](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/director-information-hub-dividends)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Execute specifically authorized payments

manual form/portal · human approval required · irreversible


Authorized finance personnel independently verify recipient payment details and apply the approved payment controls. Record receipts and investigate rejected or mismatched transfers. A released wire cannot be assumed recoverable; reconfirm the amount, recipient and authority immediately before release.

- Sources: [GOV.UK director information: dividends](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/director-information-hub-dividends)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Reconcile records and reporting obligations

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Finance and advisers reconcile payments, distribution records and any applicable tax reporting or withholding. Escalate exceptions and avoid marking the distribution complete on approval alone.

- Verify: A reviewed distribution decision with authorized payments, required records and reconciled ownership and tax treatment.
- Sources: [GOV.UK director information: dividends](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/director-information-hub-dividends)
